name: sandbox-knowledge-hub-mcp-worker
description: Cloudflare Workers deployment of the Knowledge Hub MCP server

scripts.deploy: cd .. && npm run bundle && npx wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:write: cd .. && npm run bundle && npx wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler-write.jsonc
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy && npm run deploy:write
scripts.dev: cd .. && npm run bundle && npx wrangler dev -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
